compatibility: No operational entrypoint, grant, claim, campaign allowance or executable dispatch. Historical campaign parsers must not accept this design schema.
claim_boundary: Future same-host software row-request ingress through owned four-mask output, including selected original HDF reads; no event-byte detector ingress, cache-cold, production or scientific usefulness claim.

workload.sequence: U = concatenate the three inclusive intervals ascending. Offer k=0..767 uses U[k mod 384]; reset k each run. No rotation, shuffle, substitution or independent-event multiplication. Identity=(case_id,phase,presentation_index).

frozen_identity_requirements.byte_pins_provenance: Original transform/scaler, lineage, channels and arithmetic-cpu-v2 pins in the bound historical config; future current-code reconciliation required without revising historical pins.

arrivals.horizon: H=t0+768*1000000000/rate; no submissions at or after H
arrivals.late_algorithm: At a wake process due k ascending. Mark lag>2ms missed_late without submission. Try at most 4 due nonstale offers, without waiting for consumer or lock; mark any other currently due offers missed_catchup_cap. Wake for next intended offer. At H all unattempted offers become missed_horizon; late accounting closure never submits more work. Record scheduling lag and each reason. No feedback rate adaptation.
arrivals.logging_overhead_characterization: No added workload runs: future data-free software validation plus in-run time spent in timestamp/record append. Proposed ceiling 50000 ns per event record append and 200000 ns per batch record append; exceedance invalidates instrumented case, retained without replacement. No overhead subtraction.

transport.source_token: First 16 bytes of the already verified source SHA256, only a routing tag; full source/role/config binding required at setup, not authorization by token.
transport.slot_metadata: admission_ns u64, enqueue_sequence u64, 48 reserved zero bytes; status/control counters in separate page
transport.ipc_queues: Exactly one shared ring; no multiprocessing.Queue, pipe, socket, feeder, unbounded list or per-event acknowledgement/output queue. OS semaphore/lock bookkeeping must fit separately bounded native control allocation. Shared status flags for ready/closed/error; diagnostic files not control queues.
transport.ownership: Producer owns unpublished slot, immutable after admission; consumer copies at dequeue, no payload alias escapes; credits held until owned output availability or failed/cancelled terminal record.
transport.admission: One nonblocking mutex try per submission; failure rejected_contention. With mutex and no credit rejected_capacity; otherwise publish slot+admission timestamp atomically. No blocking backpressure.
transport.comparison: No no-transport arm and no transport-benefit estimate. Full producer/process/scheduling/packing/ownership intervention measured jointly; future matched payload/path comparison needs separate design.

queue.pending_identity: Q_ring + Q_staged + X_active <= 64; producer J<=1 is not admitted and is reported separately
queue.discipline: FIFO by enqueue_sequence; producer k order; intended ties by k; consumer never reorders logical outputs. Mutex commit order linearizes operations.
queue.consumer_algorithm: When idle inspect FIFO. If count>=8 dispatch oldest8; else if oldest admission age>=1ms dispatch all available m; else wait no more than min(100us, remaining timeout) then inspect again. Actual scheduler delay logged. At producer closed dispatch any final partial immediately; while busy no concurrent HDF/scoring. Staged rows count in capacity. New arrivals after batch snapshot belong to next batch.
queue.actual_shape: m=actual dispatched logical rows,1..8; no padding, billing mapping, interpolation or timing-vector reuse
queue.drain: At H prohibit submissions, close producer accounting, dispatch all admitted pending rows FIFO including final partial. Drain completes only with Q_ring=Q_staged=X=J=0; 5s maximum from H. No extra arrivals or separate drain presentations.

selected_read_and_features.algorithm: Stable sort actual batch descriptors by prefix position, assign the j-th occurrence of each position to layer j (j starts0), process layers ascending with positions increasing in each layer, giving the minimum number of duplicate-free increasing selections; read only these selections with original HDF decoder, scatter into one owned FP64[m,2101] in FIFO presentation order. Every logical occurrence causes a returned row; no deduplication reuse. At most m HDF requests, exactly m raw rows. Stable duplicate layers and scatter require future validation.
selected_read_and_features.full_particle_semantics: Original FP64 sort/wrap, physical FP32 cast, all up to700 particles in FP64 aggregates, original mass/log/scaler rules, eight FP32 features; truth0 guard outside model input; no particle384 view/full raw load.
selected_read_and_features.scoring: One original public score call per actual batch, PCA FP64 / AE v2 FP32 reconstruction and original FP64 SSE; four strict score>threshold decisions, ties rejected, owned score/mask copies.

input_histories.global_custody: Future separately authorized study: exactly one full raw SHA256 pass before all runs, one after all runs, outside latency. They warm OS pages. No other raw custody passes or per-run rehash. Bind acquisition/lineage/transform/model/calibration identities; numerical inputs not opened in Task0050.
input_histories.per_run_setup: Fresh processes, one original6999 membership load and sort/1024 prefix, one1024x8 golden load, one candidate/threshold load. Pre gates on handle A; close A, release application raw/feature buffers, open checked handle B. Models and golden retained. Fixed cache verified on both handles. No application source prefetch.
input_histories.reopened: No post-reopen raw warm-up. Measured U first pass then U repeated pass on handle B. Pre gates touch prefix0..7; whole-file custody and earlier runs warm OS. First pass means first scheduled pass on B only, not untouched bytes.
input_histories.primed: After reopening handle B, exactly48 untimed B8 chains traverse U once,384 rows, with full outputs checked then released. Measured U twice on the same B without reset. Warm-up service and feature work counted.
input_histories.post: Drain then golden-only reference for every completed measured batch, then post gates on B and identity checks. Close B and teardown. No raw preload, cached raw/feature serving, purge, reboot, global reset or app closure.
input_histories.interpretation: Application reset, reopened HDF handle, first/repeated scheduled pass and explicit priming are distinct. Neither history establishes cold OS/page cache; cross-run state/host drift uncontrolled. Neighbor chunk decode cannot return/analyze other rows. Chunk geometry is not measured IO or miss count.

parity.fixed_gate_algorithm: Before reopen and after drain/reference: m=1..8 in ascending order, request prefix positions0..m-1; one independent golden-only public score/strict4 reference and two independent full raw->feature->public score/strict4 chains per shape. Exact feature/golden, score/mask/repeat bytes; frozen inputs/parameters/thresholds before/after.
parity.warmup_check: Every priming batch compares features byte-exact to golden; warm-up output finite/owned/strict. No extra reference calls beyond measured-batch and fixed references; warm-up not independently certified for throughput.
parity.measured_check: For every completed measured batch after t_output, compare retained features to same ordered golden bytes, retain owned score and four-mask bytes indexed by presentation, and record grouping/m plus digests. Control stalls consumer and therefore affects later latency; include its duration. After drain independently pack golden rows in exact realized FIFO grouping and call unchanged public score/strict4 once per completed batch, comparing actual score/mask bytes directly, not just hashes. No grouping is skipped, even repeats. Raw features are not retained across batches; scores/masks released after reference/post checks.
parity.coverage: Every realized grouping and shape checked; plan grouping is scheduler-dependent. No inference for unobserved groupings. Shape1..8 fixed gates are necessary but not blanket certification; B4096 science/old small windows do not certify streaming.
parity.historical_tolerances_unchanged: Same-shape score/PCA atol=rtol=1e-12 remain historical maxima; this design requires byte equality and zero decision mismatches, never enlarges tolerances. Existing arithmetic-cpu-v2 and nonfinite guards remain prerequisites.
parity.no_extra_numerical_setup: All operational numerical calls are fixed gates, priming, measured chains or measured-batch references; no additional hidden sanity/inference/reference work. Ties/ownership/error paths first covered by future data-free fixtures.
parity.independent_reference_definition: Reference separately gathers and owns golden FP32[m,8], bypasses future streaming gather/service wrapper, calls original public score once at exact same m and ordering, and independently evaluates each of four strict score>threshold comparisons (ties false), comparing direct retained score/mask bytes. Frozen public model arithmetic is shared intentionally; new transport/gather/packing/decision wrapper is not its own oracle.

timestamps.clock: Integer time.perf_counter_ns timestamps on one host and common OS monotonic timebase; future validation must verify equal epochs/rate across processes and record implementation/resolution. No assumed1ns resolution. Separate continuous/suspend-inclusive supervision; discontinuity or suspension invalidates case.
timestamps.units: ns; durations integer differences; display ms=ns/1000000

timestamps.missing: Use null plus explicit terminal reason, never zero/imputed time. Unexpected missing transition invalidates accounting; hard-stop uncertain in-flight state preserved. Intended times are formulas; phase/control timestamps do not substitute for event timestamps.

records.control_records: Fixed phase counters/gate records bounded by per-run4MiB diagnostic storage and8MiB Python/serialization memory; no per-particle/source arrays in logs. All numeric failure/partial records retained.
records.output: Owned FP64 scores768*8=6144B plus four Boolean masks768*4=3072B, indexed by presentation until same-shaped direct byte reference comparisons. Current original/copy score/mask buffers separately bounded; raw/features released. Scores transient in memory, only digests and bounded mask outputs in operational logs; no IDs/features/scores/masks curated publicly.

cutoffs: arrival horizon H by timestamp projection
abnormal stop with unresolved states retained
identities: At normal closure U_due=J=0; after normal drain Q_ring=Q_staged=X=F_admitted=K_cancelled=0, so768=M+R_capacity+R_contention+C
Completed output Boolean count=4*C, not event completions; false masks still completed
Each HDF request intent=not_started+inflight+returned+failed, disjoint at cutoff; returned rows=constructed rows+awaiting_feature+feature_inflight+feature_failed rows with stage-specific counters
Every service call intent=not_started+inflight+completed+failed; score rows and4 Boolean outputs counted only on completed call
accounting.definitions: O due intended offers; U_due not yet resolved; M producer missed without submission; S attempts; J decision in progress<=1; A admitted; Q ring/staged disjoint; X active; C owned output completed; F terminal admitted failure; K admitted cancellation on abnormal stop. Counts from linearization timestamps, never non-atomic counter snapshots. Unfinished future offers on abort separate from due misses.
accounting.denominators: Requested768/(H-t0); achieved submission S/(H-t0) and admission A/(H-t0), events/s; delivery C/768; producer miss M/768; queue rejection R/S; completed latency n=C only. State sample counts and units per run. After drain count pending separately; no invented full-horizon rate on abort.
accounting.row_scope: Unique raw IDs<=384 versus up to18432 repeated offers;1024golden approval not1024raw access. Unknown raw return after crash marked uncertain, no guessed count.
accounting.post_output_failure: An output already made available remains C even if its later parity/reference check invalidates the run; F/K contain only admitted rows without owned output. Batch numerical and reference validity is separate from boundary completion.

metrics.producer_lag: submission_ns-intended_ns for submitted; detection lag for missed separately
metrics.batch_execution: output_ns-dispatch_ns; no component subtraction for pure transport
metrics.deadline_policy: Overload/loss/100ms misses are valid observed outcomes, not automatic stops. Completed misses latency>100ms; pending overdue age>100ms separately at H/stop; overflow and producer misses separate, no imputed latency.
metrics.quantiles: Per run p50/p95/p99 on actual completed survivor values, linear convention and n; n=0 null. Preserve all slow/unfavorable data. Do not average quantiles or infer production p99/independent events. Pass/cycle and symbolic positions descriptive only; rejections can change executed input history.
